item.title: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Sys...
item.description: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Systems” From 29 September to 1 October 2026, the European Defence Agency will hold the Test and Evaluation Community Days in Kiel, Germany. This 5th edition will bring together key European stakeholders to examine how Test & Evaluation (T&E) can better support defence readiness and accelerate capability development. Discussions will address topics such as wartime experience, Test and Evaluation resources in Europe, challenges in testing autonomous system, the role of AI in T&E, the need to attract and train the next generation of T&E experts, and the contribution of T&E to certification and qualification processes, including initiatives such as the Joint Ammunition Qualification (JAQ). If you wish to present a contribution aligned with the above-mentioned topics of interest, please complete the submission form by 26 June 2026 and send it to the organizers. Submission forms and registrations here: https://lnkd.in/efDM7_gv Léo B. item.title: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium receiv...
item.description: 📢 MAJoR consortium attracts more than 200 proposals in its EDF’s first-ever FSTP sub-call ▶️ The MAJoR consortium received more than 200 proposals in their first FSTP sub-call from almost all Member States, including Ukraine, with over 70% of eligible applicants participating in an EU defence funding programme for the first time. ▶️ This resonates with one of our recent posts on the introduction of FSTP under EDF, through which the MAJoR project aims to select up to 60 innovators to contribute with their specialized technologies and expertise to the targeted innovation challenges within the project, without navigating the full EDF application process. Successful applicants will receive up to €60,000 in funding and participate in a 6-month business development support programme. A total of 3.6 million EUR is reserved for both sub-calls within MAJoR. 📍 Next steps Looking ahead, the second MAJoR sub-call and the first sub-call under the BATTLEVERSE project, will take place, offering further opportunities for innovative companies to participate in EDF-funded projects. 🚀More information on FSTP in EDF: https://lnkd.in/eisZFtrF Léo B. item.title: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows...
item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. Léo B. item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. The European Defence Fund’s annual Work Programme for 2026 will dedicate €1 billion to support collaborative defence R&D projects. With this new round of investments, the European Commission’s flagship for defence R&D will address 31 collaborative defence R&D topics, in critical and urgent areas in line with the commonly agreed capability development priorities. ▶️ More information on the dedicated press release: https://lnkd.in/eWeVzM-p. item.title: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All projec...
item.description: 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way 📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly. To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices. ⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned ! 🎙️ Aleš Lipnik, Doit-R Solutions Aleksander majeric, TECES, Green Tech Cluster), coordinator of the INDY, Energy independent and efficient deployable military camps project (EDF 2021) and partner in NOMAD PROJECT EU(EDF 2021) and Sentinel Project (EDF 2024) Iztok Spacapan, Instrumentation Technologies and the ARCHYTAS (EDF) project (EDF 2023) Žiga Mlinarič, SkyLabs d.o.o. and the Staalion project (EDF 2023 SME development action project) Jan Knezevic, SSRD and the Small UAS project (EDF 2024) Ziga Brencic, Jozef Stefan Institute and the SQORPION project (EDF 2024) 🙋‍♂️ Léo B., Alain Dinis 💡 🌎, Alexandre Hervin, Joachim Finkielman, Paloma López Diez, Václav Syruček, Victor Hartong, Kristýna Helm, Goran Basarac, Grubesic Bruno The European Network of Defence-related Regions, European Defence Fund, Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe (ASD), European Union Security and Defence, European Defence Agency.

item.description: ▶️ Save The Date! 📅 3-4 June 2026 ENDR Conference Gijón 2026 - “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry” In the framework of The European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Asturias Hub defensa ( ASTURIAS HUB DE DEFENSA) - Asturias Technology Business Association for the development of the Defence Industry - will host the European conference “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”. 🗺️ The event will take place Gijón, Asturias (Spain), on 3-4 June 2026, at the Laboral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial. 🔎 The conference will bring together key policymakers, industry leaders, SMEs, and stakeholders from the defence and dual-use entrepreneurial ecosystem, alongside civilian technology innovators, clusters, and defence business associations. It will also engage academia, research and technology organisations, higher education and VET providers, research funding bodies, specialised media, as well as EU, national, and regional authorities, and international organisations. Registration: https://lnkd.in/eT2Hjm8T Léo B. item.description: 🔙 Be kind: rewind. Last June 18th, the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All team gathered at the Paris Air Show the EDF interested organisations during a matchmaking event held on Wednesday 18 June evening at the French National Air & Space Museum. The EOA consortium partner Systematic Paris-Region together with EEN TONIC organized this event and welcomed SMEs, startups, large firms and other types of organizations to take part in prescheduled meetings as well as informal networking around the upcoming EDF funding opportunities. We thank all the registered participants who came and are looking forward to organizing other similar events in the future! item.description: 🔥🔥🔥 EUDIS Accelerator: new call for applications open! ▶️ Following the strong momentum of the EUDIS Business Accelerator — with over 450 applications from 27 countries in the previous cohort — a new call for applications is now open for Europe’s most promising defence and dual-use start-ups and scale-ups. ▶️ Supported by the European Defence Fund and DG DEFIS, the EUDIS Business Accelerator is an 8-month programme designed to help companies access and scale within the European defence ecosystem. ▶️ Selected companies of the 3rd cohort will benefit from tailored strategic support and expert coaching, on-site bootcamps across Europe to discover the European defence ecosystem, direct connections with end-users, industry leaders and investors and a €120,000 non-dilutive funding voucher per company. 🔥 Apply before 30 May 2026! https://lnkd.in/dDde8yzp. 📍 Register now to the information webinar of 29 April 2026: https://tally.so/r/PdYR8V Léo B.
